import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final long flow_inf = (long)1e18;
    static int n, t;
    static String[] sci, cap;
    static int[][] dis = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] dis2 = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[65][12][12][12][12];

    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        List<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int n, s, t;
        int[] level, ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void add_edge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            int m = edges.size();
            adj.get(v).add(m - 2);
            adj.get(u).add(m - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            q.clear();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                    level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int& cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj.get(v).size(); cid++) {
                int id = adj.get(v).get(cid);
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(id);
                int u = e.u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                edges.get(id).flow += tr;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, flow_inf)) != 0) {
                    f += pushed;
                }
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        sci = new String[n];
        cap = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            cap[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(dis2[i], -1);
        }

        boolean[][] isValid = new boolean[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Y' || sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    isValid[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    isValid[i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS1 function
        class BFS1 {
            void run(int x, int y) {
                Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dis[i], -1);
                }
                dis[x][y] = 0;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] u = q.poll();
                    int ux = u[0], uy = u[1];
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        int vx = ux + dx[i];
                        int vy = uy + dy[i];
                        if (vx >= 0 && vy >= 0 && vx < n && vy < n && isValid[vx][vy] && dis[vx][vy] == -1) {
                            dis[vx][vy] = dis[ux][uy] + 1;
                            q.offer(new int[]{vx, vy});
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        if (dis[i][j] == -1) dis[i][j] = 1000000000;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize BFS1 for 'Z' cells
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    new BFS1().run(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]> sc = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> cp = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    sc.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = cap[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    cp.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int total_nodes = sc.size() + cp.size() + 2;
        Dinic flow = new Dinic(total_nodes, 0, total_nodes - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < sc.size(); i++) {
            long c = sci[sc.get(i)[0]].charAt(sc.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.add_edge(0, i + 1, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < cp.size(); i++) {
            long c = cap[cp.get(i)[0]].charAt(cp.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.add_edge(sc.size() + 1 + i, total_nodes - 1, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sc.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < cp.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, sc.get(i)[0], sc.get(i)[1], cp.get(j)[0], cp.get(j)[1])) {
                    flow.add_edge(i + 1, sc.size() + 1 + j, 10000000);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.flow());
    }

    static boolean pos(int tt, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < tt) return false;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return true;
        if (tt >= t) return false;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= tt) return false;
        if (dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] == 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];
            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n || yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y' || sci[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
            if (pos(tt + 1, xx, yy, x, y))
                return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
        }
        return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
    }
}
